21.03.2025 FA No.33 of 2025
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J. 
The proposed Appeal under Section 
96 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 
has been filed challenging the judgment 
and decree dated 28.02.2025, passed by 
learned Civil Judge (Senior Division), 
Roorkee, District Haridwar in Original Suit 
No.80 of 2005, by which the learned Judge 
has declared the impugned sale-deed 
dated 19.08.2004 as null and void and has 
further decreed the suit for perpetual 
injunction. 
2. Heard Mr. Navneet Kaushik, learned 
counsel for the proposed appellant and Mr. 
Siddhartha Singh, learned counsel for the 
caveator/respondent no.1 - plaintiff.
3. Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate has 
sought time to file an Application under 
Order XLI Rule 11 CPC.
4. Original Record is summoned.
5. List on 03.04.2025.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
